original.method: Hash every selected production/API Java input; tokenize only raw matches, excluding comments and string literals for active identifiers. No registration code executed.

current.method: Hash every selected production/API Java input; tokenize only raw matches, excluding comments and string literals for active identifiers. No registration code executed.

comment_corrections: Source blueprint cell aggregation, before native crafting and item-container handling.
Shared blueprint aggregation and optimization; native recipe selection and container lookup stay at the platform boundary.
LGPL-3.0-or-later. Existing port blueprint lists remain readable.
LGPL-3.0-or-later. Recognizes keyed grids and earlier list layouts; entries use native version serializers.

example_limit: Three manually source-derived parameter examples, not executed original/current Java or actual registered crafting recipes; no exhaustive optimization equivalence claim.

preconditions: Same item identity after source unification, sufficient counts, qualified autocraftable crafting recipe.
No earlier matching static machine recipe; valid program, powered idle machine and output space.
Ordinary non-container items; extra tag is only a custom display name, not stored contents.
Manually loaded ordinary GUI inputs; source automation containsInput has its own strict filter and is not claimed to differ.
nbt_matching_contract.scope: Untagged recipe specimens permit extra input NBT in the source matcher; current exact-input flag rejects extra tags/components. Finite source-guard comparison, not live NBT or crafting tests.

punchcard_conclusion: Original manual calls it an unfinished idea; no explicit built-in binding found. Enumerators/printer stub alone do not prove a missing completed default gameplay feature. External enum binding remains possible.
preserved_boundaries: Original zero-sized inputs are valid and still require a matching specimen; current uses an explicit retained one-item catalyst.
Program slot, keyed grid plus earlier port list format, native cache/filter, per-cell container lookup and shared optimization are present; not complete gameplay or compatibility acceptance.
Advanced-table blueprint slot limit is one in both implementations; do not infer normal-GUI loss of a whole stack from new ItemStack alone.
Source program data and modern names/components remain distinct from old-world migration; immutable copy/update protections are retained.
limits: Source analysis only; no target Java initialization, native decompilation, Gradle, tests, game, build or push.

No full crafting corpus, reload lifecycle, custom recipe remainders, external items/tags/permissions, all tools/keys, manual blueprint interactions, independent saved-world restart or legacy item-ID migration acceptance.
Whitespace plus two scope explanations only; no gameplay or user material changes.

root_revalidation.method: Rehash actual sources/platform views and scope manifests; compare baseline snapshots, complete ordered code, raw literal positions, comments/directives; trace ordinary GUI, tag-preserving unification and final machine matcher. Four source conditions, not target Java or gameplay tests.
